name: python-graceful-shutdown
title: Python graceful shutdown
blurb: An HTTP server whose SIGTERM path is a tested contract: non-daemon request threads so an in-flight response is never truncated, a drain watcher in its own thread because shutdown() deadlocks on the serving one, the listening socket closed so new clients are refused instead of queued, keep-alive requests answered 503 rather than counted, a bounded drain that exits 1 when work outlives the deadline, and a second signal that exits 130 instead of hanging a deploy
default_description: A stdlib HTTP server that finishes in-flight work before it exits, with the shutdown sequence covered by process-level tests.
next_steps: uv venv --allow-existing .venv && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff

verify.name: install
verify.cmd: uv venv --quiet --allow-existing .venv && uv pip install --quiet --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff

detect.contains: the listening socket was still accepting after the drain began
